abnormal_basis: Joint engineering impairment: winding resistance +4%, added viscous friction2e-6 Nms/rad, thrust coefficient-1%, load torque coefficient+1%. Reduced after the initial candidate exceeded duty1 at the aged-battery/low-SOC/payload reserve corner. Not a measured motor lifetime stage.
scope: Common parameters for all rotors; independent rotor speeds, currents and temperatures
limitations: No mapping to hours, cycles, SOH or RUL.
ESC efficiency and Coulomb friction stay at the healthy fitted values.
Custom profiles use the same resistance/thrust/torque ratios; added viscous friction scales with their healthy torque coefficient. This is an unmeasured engineering transfer.
